title: Deadlands Chandelier, Caged
flavorText: Daedric flames burn within these ornate, caged sconces. The light they grant may seem harmless enough, but the fires of Oblivion often cast darkness upon the soul.
name: Deadlands Chandelier, Caged

title: Xi-Tsei Stone Idol
flavorText: Though no blood or moss mars this Argonian idol, similar symbols decorate the infamous Xi-Tsei xanmeer where the Fourth Imperial Legion met its end in 1E 2820. Did this particular stone guardian watch over the legion's bloody massacre? Who can say?
name: Xi-Tsei Stone Idol

title: Entwined Snakes, Crystal Holder
flavorText: An ancient Argonian artisan captured this endless struggle between fang-baring serpents, crafting a stone dance of poison and fang that can hold a crystalline light. The jaws of these snakes gape open, ready to hold another light source of your choice.
name: Entwined Snakes, Crystal Holder

title: Banner, Tattered Mehrunes Dagon
flavorText: Every ambitious soul needs grit to prevail—so it's fitting that grit worked its way deep into the fabric of this well-worn blood-red banner of the Razor Prince!
name: Banner, Tattered Mehrunes Dagon

title: Inert Oblivion Gate
flavorText: This foreboding structure once held the promise of entry to Oblivion, though now it stands curiously silent. Or does it?
name: Inert Oblivion Gate

title: Deadlands Pillar, Tall Inscribed
flavorText: With its eerie crimson markings, this carved pillar brings the weighty and sometimes malice-laden presence of the Daedra to any area it dominates.
name: Deadlands Pillar, Tall Inscribed

title: Seal of the Ambitions

traitDescription: Increases Max Health by |cffffff5.2|r%.

flavorText: Only Companions may equip this item.

flavorText: Only Companions may equip this item.

traitDescription: Increases Max Health by |cffffff2.6|r%.

flavorText: Only Companions may equip this item.

flavorText: Only Companions may equip this item.

title: Driftwood Birdhouse
flavorText: The twists and whorls of the driftwood give this birdhouse a truly unique appearance.
name: Driftwood Birdhouse

title: Zenithar Wood Sculpture
flavorText: Zenithar-worshipers often keep small devotional anvils in their home. This wooden variant is light enough to carry outdoors.
name: Zenithar Wood Sculpture

title: Nibenese Pinwheel
flavorText: This colorful pinwheel often appears in Nibenese landscaping, lending a sense of regal frivolity to any garden.
name: Nibenese Pinwheel

title: Stallion Portrait
flavorText: A proud white stallion painted in profile. Artwork like this is greatly prized by Leyawiin nobility.
name: Stallion Portrait

title: Su-Zahleel Knot-Tapestry
flavorText: The Copper-Eyes are known for their inventive use of rope in artwork. This tapestry depicts a leaping trout.
name: Su-Zahleel Knot-Tapestry

title: Topal Shell Collection
flavorText: The shores of the Trans-Niben seem to attract all manner of shells. This pristine collection was assembled with great care.
name: Topal Shell Collection

title: Razor Brand
flavorText: This heavy iron brand bears a rough likeness of Mehrunes Razor at the scalding end. Likely reserved for initiation rituals.
name: Razor Brand

title: Lucky Sigil Stone
flavorText: This striated, granite sphere is not a true morpholith, but it might pass as the genuine article if not for its small size.
name: Lucky Sigil Stone

title: Daedroth-tooth Scrimshaw
flavorText: A deranged artisan inscribed macabre imagery onto this Daedroth tooth. A truly unsettling work of art.
name: Daedroth-tooth Scrimshaw

title: Dagon Devotional Figurine
flavorText: Hewn from polished obsidian, this four-armed idol is clearly a depiction of the Prince of Cataclysm, Mehrunes Dagon.
name: Dagon Devotional Figurine

title: Cepaliarch Idol
flavorText: This vaguely octopean image of Hermaeus Mora secretes some kind of slime regardless of how often it's cleaned.
name: Cepaliarch Idol

title: Skin-Painter's Mysterium
flavorText: Grotesque images of body motification appear on every page of this manual--essential reading for any occult tattooist.
name: Skin-Painter's Mysterium

title: Intrigue on the Nibenay
flavorText: A strategy game made popular by legendary battlemage, Leona Bascilius. A single game can sometimes last days.
name: Intrigue on the Nibenay

title: Teeba-Bassu Raquet
flavorText: The most popular pastime in northern Black Marsh, Teeba-Bassu, requires a sturdy wooden raquet like this one.
name: Teeba-Bassu Raquet

title: Blackwood Boast Deck
flavorText: An unusual deck of cards that instead features thick wooden plates. Apparently, only Argonians have the skill to shuffle them.
name: Blackwood Boast Deck

title: Mage's War Dice
flavorText: Crafted from polished geodes, this handful of purple dice feel unsually heavy.
name: Mage's War Dice

title: Diamond Duel Set
flavorText: Adapted from a long-forgotten Aldmeric ritual, this ancient Imperial boardgame is a favorite pastime of Nibenese nobles.
name: Diamond Duel Set

title: Majestic Lawn Marbles
flavorText: Despite its popularity, the game of lawn marbles is very difficult to play in the marshy climes of Blackwood.
name: Majestic Lawn Marbles

title: Archein Claw File
flavorText: A hunk of swamp pummice used to sharpen the claws of Argonian radiers.
name: Archein Claw File

title: Black Mud Facial Scrub
flavorText: Imperial stylists often extol the restorative properties of the thick, black mud of northern Black Marsh.
name: Black Mud Facial Scrub

title: Marsh Mint Gum-Rub
flavorText: Argonians harvest the potent mint plants around Gideon for use in food, but Imperials often use the leaves for oral hygeine.
name: Marsh Mint Gum-Rub

title: Deepmurk Scale Lacquer
flavorText: Members of the Su-Zahleel tribe sometimes treat their scales with this thick alchemical brew to enhance their luster.
name: Deepmurk Scale Lacquer

title: Rockgrove Bath Salts
flavorText: Alchemists often use the pungent swamp salts around Rockgrove in luxurious bathing products.
name: Rockgrove Bath Salts

title: Ruby Straight-Razor
flavorText: This ruby-studded shaving tool likely came form the Imperial City itself.
name: Ruby Straight-Razor

title: Snail Shell Inkwell
flavorText: A marsh snail's thick shell has a thousand-and-one uses in Black Marsh, but use as an inkwell is one of the most popular.
name: Snail Shell Inkwell

title: Iron Shears
flavorText: The industrious mage-librarians of the Nibenay Basin use these heavy iron shears to cut reams of parchment in a single snip.
name: Iron Shears

title: Coffin-Handle Paperweight
flavorText: The constant erosion of Blackwood's swamps often reveals long-buried coffins. Locals continue to find new uses for the handles.
name: Coffin-Handle Paperweight

title: Marsh Giant Ink
flavorText: Argonians sometimes harvest the blood of fallen marsh giants for use in paints and inks.
name: Marsh Giant Ink

title: Naga-Quill Pen
flavorText: Taken from the head of a Naga raider, this frightful writing tool is perfect for adventurous and warlike scribes.
name: Naga-Quill Pen

title: Prowler-Skin Vellum
flavorText: The rugged hide of marsh prowlers makes for very durable parchment--an essential item for enterprising Blackwood scholars.
name: Prowler-Skin Vellum

title: Cypress Wood Spoon
flavorText: Argonians use the sturdy knees of Blackwood cypress trees for all manner of tools, including spoons.
name: Cypress Wood Spoon

title: Needlerush Swamp Kabob Set
flavorText: The rigid stems of this native plant often find a use in Blackmarsh cuisine, adding a loamy aftertaste that Leyawiins love.
name: Needlerush Swamp Kabob Set

title: Clamshell Ladle
flavorText: Clever Argonian artisans often make use of shells for household needs. This masterfully assembled ladle is one such example.
name: Clamshell Ladle

title: Antique Blackwood Cutlery
flavorText: Imperial chefs are renowned for their skill with unnervingly sharp cutlery. These knives are very sharp indeed.
name: Antique Blackwood Cutlery

title: Sturdy Iron Muzzle
flavorText: A self-hating werewolf might use this heavy muzzle to spare others from their lycanthropic curse.
name: Sturdy Iron Muzzle

title: Crumpled Wanted Posters
flavorText: This collection of hand-rendered wanted posters entreats people to keep on the lookout for werewolves in their midst.
name: Crumpled Wanted Posters

title: Silver-Studded Scourge
flavorText: Werewolves seeking penance for their monstrous deeds sometimes use flails like this for ritual self-flagellation.
name: Silver-Studded Scourge

title: Wolfblood Figural Urn
flavorText: This masterfully crafted vessel features various lupine shapes and motifs. The red staining inside does not come from wine.
name: Wolfblood Figural Urn

title: Dovah-Fly Trap
flavorText: This painstakingly assembled reed trap seems specially designed for trapping iridescent dovah-flies.
name: Dovah-Fly Trap

title: Wamasu Leather Bellows
flavorText: The rugged, knobby hide of a wamasu is perfect for large, frequently used bellows like this.
name: Wamasu Leather Bellows

title: Swampgrass Whip-Snare
flavorText: Sharpened sedge leaves and tightly wound leather make this one of the most painful traps in Tamriel.
name: Swampgrass Whip-Snare

title: Miniature Spinning Wheel
flavorText: This ingenious invention allows the tailors of Leyawiin to spin small quantities of thread from the comfort of their rockers.
name: Miniature Spinning Wheel

title: Silver Lamp-Harness
flavorText: Night riders, keen on avoiding the prowling beasts of Blackwood, often clip their lanterns onto decorative harnesses like this.
name: Silver Lamp-Harness

title: Mudcrab Cracking-Clamp
flavorText: Golden grips and flawless steel make this culinary tool as beautiful as it is functional.
name: Mudcrab Cracking-Clamp

title: Mudcrab Claw Pipe
flavorText: Old salts desperate for a smoke sometimes fashion pipes out of a hollow crab claws. The residue on this one smells of skooma.
name: Mudcrab Claw Pipe

title: Smuggler's Throat-Pouch
flavorText: Argonian smugglers often hide contraband under their tongues using water-tight pouches like this one.
name: Smuggler's Throat-Pouch

title: Skooma Sorting-Tray
flavorText: This wide platter features several hollows--perfect for sorting skooma crystals by size and potency.
name: Skooma Sorting-Tray

title: Swamp Jelly Fermenter
flavorText: The deadly Argonian drug, daril, requires long fermentation in the gut of a swamp jelly. This one was hollowed out by a master.
name: Swamp Jelly Fermenter

title: Adder-Tap Extractor
flavorText: A complex mechanism for extracting the venom from Black Marsh's dreaded moon adders. You can't make daril without it!
name: Adder-Tap Extractor

title: Ancient Daril Mortar
flavorText: The use of daril--a potent Argonian drug--dates back thousands of years. This masterfully cut stone mortar is the proof.
name: Ancient Daril Mortar

title: Teeba-Bassu Ball
flavorText: This hard rubber ball is wrapped in death hopper hide, affording a teeba-player a perfect grip, even in swampy conditions.
name: Teeba-Bassu Ball

title: Leyawiin Toad Raft
flavorText: The soggy conditions of Blackwood make nautical toys quite popular. This tiny raft seems tailor-made for a toad.
name: Leyawiin Toad Raft

title: Crab-Snatcher
flavorText: This grasping tool features a multi-toothed claw and a simple pully-system--a perfect tool for grabbing mudcrabs at a distance.
name: Crab-Snatcher

title: Castle Giovesse Playset
flavorText: A tiny replica of legendary Castle Giovesse. Painstakingly assembled, this probably belonged to a child of special significance.
name: Castle Giovesse Playset

title: Lilmothiit Fox-Kite
flavorText: A sleek paper kite, painted bright orange and featuring a real fox's tail.
name: Lilmothiit Fox-Kite

title: Xi-Tsei Puzzle Pyramid
flavorText: A mind-bending collection of puzzle blocks. When assembled correctly, the blocks form a small replica of the legendary xanmeer.
name: Xi-Tsei Puzzle Pyramid

title: Onkabra Clay Vase
flavorText: The distinctive red clay of the Onkabra delta makes for very distinctive pottery.
name: Onkabra Clay Vase

title: Stainless Swamp Kettle
flavorText: This sturdy, lizard-shaped kettle shows no sign of corrosion--a valuable feature for the moist climes of Blackwood.
name: Stainless Swamp Kettle

title: Blackwood Ash-Fired Bowl
flavorText: This lovely bowl features the distinctive ash glaze of Gideon--a technique discovered after the Great Burn of 1E 2828.
name: Blackwood Ash-Fired Bowl

title: Niben-Crystal Serving Plate
flavorText: Nibenese crystal is renowned for its precision and clean, transparent finish. This plate is a perfect example.
name: Niben-Crystal Serving Plate

title: Commemorative Liberation Platter
flavorText: This polished silver platter features the Redguard warrior, Sai Sahan, in profile. A fitting tribute to Leyawiin's liberator.
name: Commemorative Liberation Platter

title: Glass Stallion Decanter
flavorText: A master glassbolower etched several equine motifs into the surface of this crystaline vessel. A true work of art.
name: Glass Stallion Decanter

title: Driftwood Slapjack
flavorText: The decorative driftwood grip and polished riverstone weight make this sap as attractive as it is dangerous.
name: Driftwood Slapjack

title: Blackwood Manacles
flavorText: Lined with rough wamasu skin and capable of a vice-like cinch, no amount of mud will let a criminal slip these cuffs.
name: Blackwood Manacles

title: Fourth Legion Blindfold
flavorText: These specially designed masks make dealing with captured Argonian guerillas far easier.
name: Fourth Legion Blindfold

title: Leyawiin Watch Insignia
flavorText: Plainclothed watchmen often carry this bronze, horse-shaped insignia as proof of their membership in Leyawiin's city guard.
name: Leyawiin Watch Insignia

title: Gideon Alley Map
flavorText: This weathered map doesn't look like much, but it illustrates the crime-infested alleys of Gideon in considerable detail.
name: Gideon Alley Map

title: Stendarr the Just Devotional
flavorText: A horn-shaped ivory devotional. Peacekeepers often carry these tokens of Stendarr to ward off evil and give them courage.
name: Stendarr the Just Devotional

title: Gideon Studded Horseshoe
flavorText: The gifted farriers of Leyawiin created these shoes to help horses navigate the muddy wilds of Blackwood.
name: Gideon Studded Horseshoe

title: Hardwood Mud-Scraper
flavorText: This lacquered oaken scraper keeps the boots and floors of Gideon clean, on even the rainiest days.
name: Hardwood Mud-Scraper

title: Eki-Xaht Feedbag
flavorText: The frog-leather feedbags of the Eki-Xaht tribe are watertight, allowing their livestock to eat grubs and rice without spillage.
name: Eki-Xaht Feedbag

title: Legionary Camp Prefect's Mallet
flavorText: Legionary camp prefects often carry a polished steel mallet as a symbol of their rank and authority.
name: Legionary Camp Prefect's Mallet

title: Longhouse Spade
flavorText: This polished steel spade bears the antlered coat of the Longhouse Emperors. Likely a gift for a groundbreaking ceremony.
name: Longhouse Spade

title: Woolen Plow-Grips
flavorText: These verdant green grip-covers are almost too lovely to use. The woolen interior keeps hands warm on cold Blackwood mornings.
name: Woolen Plow-Grips

title: Cypress Wood Comb
flavorText: A fine lacquer finish and decorative blossom motifs make this comb a perfect example of the Blackwood Nibenese aesthetic.
name: Cypress Wood Comb

title: Leyawiins' Gambeson Quilt
flavorText: A talented seamstress converted this soldier's quilted gambeson into a warm blanket. Perfect for cold, damp nights in Gideon.
name: Leyawiins' Gambeson Quilt

title: Wamasu Gaiters
flavorText: These sturdy shin-coverings protect foragers and explorers from the bite of thorns, nettles, and spooked adders.
name: Wamasu Gaiters

title: Opal-Studded Hairbrush
flavorText: Imported from Pellitine across the Trans-Niben, this opulent brush likely belonged to one of Leyawiin's many duchesses.
name: Opal-Studded Hairbrush

title: Nibenese Bed Warmer
flavorText: When filled with hot coals, this filigreed brass pan can make chilly nights on the coast of the Topal Bay a bit more cozy.
name: Nibenese Bed Warmer

title: Silken Hat Box
flavorText: This flamboyant, silk-covered box might be even more colorful than the hat it once carried.
name: Silken Hat Box

title: Bat-Skin Banquet Mask
flavorText: This macabre mask was fashioned from the membranous wings of a Blackwood bat. A very popular accoutrement in vampiric circles.
name: Bat-Skin Banquet Mask

title: Reed-Woven Visor
flavorText: The dense canopy of Blackwood grants vampires respite from the sun, but this visor provides even more protection for the eyes.
name: Reed-Woven Visor

title: Scarlet Lace Kerchief
flavorText: This lacy kerchief is dyed deep red — a convenient color for someone intent on hiding bloodstains.
name: Scarlet Lace Kerchief

title: Red Diamond Chalice
flavorText: A fine golden chalice, studded with red precious stones. Despite its beauty, the rusty stains inside imply a bloody history.
name: Red Diamond Chalice

title: Topal Glass Blood-Phial
flavorText: A rust-colored film coats the interior of this fine crystal phial. A wealthy vampire may have used it to hold a midday snack.
name: Topal Glass Blood-Phial

title: Ancient Sacrificial Funnel
flavorText: Argonian etchings of Sithis cover this stone funnel. Judging by the stains, it probably played a role in some grisly ritual.
name: Ancient Sacrificial Funnel

title: Nails of Saint Kaladas
flavorText: According to legend, Saint Kaladas used these gnarled, iron nails to assemble the original pulpit in the Chapel of Zenithar.
name: Nails of Saint Kaladas

title: Dragon's-Scale Powder
flavorText: Rouge powder said to be made from Dragon scales, but more likely comes from crushed snowberries.
name: Dragon's-Scale Powder

title: Countess Caro's Perfume
flavorText: Purportedly made to smell exactly like the Countess herself. It has notes of cinnamon.
name: Countess Caro's Perfume

title: Brandy Musk Cologne
flavorText: Have you ever wanted to smell like your local tavern? Now you can!
name: Brandy Musk Cologne

title: Golden False Lashes
flavorText: These expertly cut feathers meant for the eyes are dipped in lightweight gold dust to create an opulent display when blinking.
name: Golden False Lashes

title: Silverskin Cheek Dust
flavorText: Sparkling dust made to highlight the cheekbones and draw attention to the face, made from powdered silverskin scales.
name: Silverskin Cheek Dust

title: Sun-Blessed Feathers
flavorText: Adornments worn by many Argonians in Gideon either on the eyes or crest of the head. It's considered a modern look.
name: Sun-Blessed Feathers

title: Cracked Morihaus Statuette
flavorText: Perhaps this effigy was once magnificent, but it has been cracked and lost its shine over time. It was once well cared for.
name: Cracked Morihaus Statuette

title: Charm of Dibella
flavorText: A small, delicately carved depiction of Dibella, small enough to fit in the palm of a hand. It looks worn and forgotten.
name: Charm of Dibella

title: Chukka-Sei Token
flavorText: A small clay token symbolizing the completion of a Chukka-Sei trial. It is stamped with the likeness of a swamp fern.
name: Chukka-Sei Token

title: Tree Minder's Cane
flavorText: A walking stick, carried by a Tree Minder of an Argonian tribe. It is incredibly lightweight and carved in a knob at the end.
name: Tree Minder's Cane

title: Nocturnal's Effigy
flavorText: A crudely-wrought depiction of Nocturnal made from dark, glossy obsidian. It looks slightly ominous when held in the light.
name: Nocturnal's Effigy

title: Imperial Dragon Brooch
flavorText: An intricate carving in the shape of a Dragon, very meticulously done. This brooch inspires reverance.
name: Imperial Dragon Brooch

title: Baked Mud Sipping Bowl
flavorText: A small bowl sculpted from baked mud and hardened to prevent cracks. One edge has a deep divot to make it easier to drink from.
name: Baked Mud Sipping Bowl

title: Imperial Canteen
flavorText: Carried by Imperial soldiers years ago. The rim is rusted and the symbol painted onto the side is worn, but recognizable.
name: Imperial Canteen

title: Sap Rimmed Mug
flavorText: Whether or not the sap comes from an actual Hist tree is hard to say, but it certainly sweetens any drink poured inside.
name: Sap Rimmed Mug

title: Kaladas Inn Stein
flavorText: A fine, pewter stein for ale that comes directly from the Kaladas Inn in Leyawiin.
name: Kaladas Inn Stein

title: Goblet of the Council
flavorText: The Elder Council's sigil is stamped upon the iron bowl and dark rubies line the stem.
name: Goblet of the Council

title: Fermented Snake Rum
flavorText: An incredibly pungent alcohol made from snake bile and diluted venom. It is said to knock even the hardiest on their tails.
name: Fermented Snake Rum

title: Naga Fishing Rod
flavorText: This is much longer than the typical fishing rod, and instead of a hook there is a long, needle-like fang at the end.
name: Naga Fishing Rod

title: Shallow Silt Strainer
flavorText: Fashioned to sift through the dark swamp mud for small treasures such as eggs, bugs, and animal bones.
name: Shallow Silt Strainer

title: Swamp Moss Scraper
flavorText: This tool has tiny serrated teeth at one end and a smooth edge at the other, for cutting the fine moss and collecting it.
name: Swamp Moss Scraper

title: Touchless Bait Applicator
flavorText: For those who are averse to handling live bait, this strange contraption will spear it for you with no contact. How nice!
name: Touchless Bait Applicator

title: Elaborate Shellfish Knife
flavorText: The Empire loves their shellfish, and this jeweled knife is specially made for cutting the tender flesh for eating. With style!
name: Elaborate Shellfish Knife

title: Palm Sized Vossa-Satl
flavorText: This tiny vossa-satl uses tree frogs the size of coins in order to produce its characteristic sound.
name: Palm Sized Vossa-Satl

title: Snakeskin Tambourine
flavorText: A tambourine made from the skin of a dark, giant snake that frequents the swamps.
name: Snakeskin Tambourine

title: Baked Clay Music Box
flavorText: Made from the vibrant red clay that surrounds Gideon, this small music box has a deep, throaty sound to it.
name: Baked Clay Music Box

title: Horn of the Empire
flavorText: The horn of an ox fashioned into a loud instrument, possibly once used to signal Imperial troops during wartime.
name: Horn of the Empire

title: Golden Strung Lute
flavorText: This lute has strings made out of gold. It makes it nearly impossible to play, but nonetheless beautiful.
name: Golden Strung Lute

title: Castle Leyawiin Hammer
flavorText: Speciality hammers made for the upkeep of Leyawiin Castle, stamped with the offical seal.
name: Castle Leyawiin Hammer

title: Saxhleel Bone Knuckles
flavorText: Bones from various swamp creatures make up these false knuckles that protect the hand while crafting.
name: Saxhleel Bone Knuckles

title: Argonian Chisel
flavorText: A small, simple chisel made from sharpened stone and sturdy branches.
name: Argonian Chisel

title: Frogskin Pouch
flavorText: A rare frog not often found in the outskirts of Gideon makes a fine purse with a glossy red sheen.
name: Frogskin Pouch

title: Perfumed Circlet Polisher
flavorText: A decadent polisher that polishes circlets while also giving the wearer a pleasant odor.
name: Perfumed Circlet Polisher

title: Foul Waterlogged Journal
flavorText: This journal supposedly belonged to an adventeruer in Gideon before he went missing. It smells of excrement.
name: Foul Waterlogged Journal

title: Argonian Style Pamphlet
flavorText: A pamphlet encouraging young Argonians to take risks with their fashion, showcasing outfits with Imperial touches.
name: Argonian Style Pamphlet

title: Keshu the Black Fin Poster
flavorText: A large poster with a painting of Keshu the Black Fin. Perfect for any decorating needs.
name: Keshu the Black Fin Poster

title: Ancestor Moth Anatomy
flavorText: An incredibly detailed rendering of an Ancestor Moth, complete with names, terms and talented painting.
name: Ancestor Moth Anatomy

title: Fourth Legion Signum
flavorText: This ancient Imperial standard may have been carried by one of General Sardecus's servants during the Blackwater War.
name: Fourth Legion Signum

title: Zuuk's Scrollcase
flavorText: Zuuk, the Kothringi knight and confidant of Empress Tavia, may have carried secret missives in this decorative case.
name: Zuuk's Scrollcase

title: Stuffed Cuddly Hopper
flavorText: No one would call a death hopper cute, but this squishable stuffed animal certainly is. It croaks when squeezed.
name: Stuffed Cuddly Hopper

title: Argonian Ragamuffin Doll
flavorText: A Nibenese toymaker or seamstress must have made this for a human child. Argonians don't play with rag dolls.
name: Argonian Ragamuffin Doll

title: Nibenese Princess Doll
flavorText: The painted features of this porcelain doll are perfect, but it's the clothing that stands out. The tiny ball gown is lovely.
name: Nibenese Princess Doll

title: Kothringi Humming Doll
flavorText: Dolls of this unusual style feature a clever arrangement of air bladders and reeds inside. They hum when squeezed.
name: Kothringi Humming Doll

title: Gemmian Wax Child
flavorText: A century ago, the brilliant Leyawiin dollmaker Gemmia was famed for her lifelike wax dolls. They are still prized today.
name: Gemmian Wax Child

title: Harvest's End Table Runner
flavorText: Embroidered with images of bountiful crops, this table decoration is typically displayed on the Harvest's End holiday.
name: Harvest's End Table Runner

title: Nibenese Wedding Pillow
flavorText: This small pillow is embroidered with the newlyweds' family trees. It's a traditional wedding gift to bless the union.
name: Nibenese Wedding Pillow

title: Serpent's Tongue Doily
flavorText: Serpent's Tongue is a striking wildflower of Black Marsh. This lace doily captures the delicate shape of its blooms and vines.
name: Serpent's Tongue Doily

title: Ancestor-Silk Shawl
flavorText: The ancestor moth of Nibenay produces a silk prized across the Empire.  Some believe these shawls hold memories of the dead.
name: Ancestor-Silk Shawl

title: Kothringi Six-Reed Mat
flavorText: Kothringi artisans perfected a technique for weaving reeds of different colors and textures into decorative mats.
name: Kothringi Six-Reed Mat

title: Pungent Fleshfly Charm
flavorText: Carved from hardened resin into the shape of a fleshfly, this small charm smells bitter and is said to repel insects.
name: Pungent Fleshfly Charm

title: Lover's Diary
flavorText: A small journal bound in red leather. Anything written in its pages disappears at dawn.
name: Lover's Diary

title: Leyawiin Paired Bells
flavorText: Ring one of these small horsehead-shaped bells, and the other bell rings too--as long as they aren't more than a bowshot apart.
name: Leyawiin Paired Bells

title: Welkynd Stone Swan Hairpin
flavorText: Welkynd stone, found in Ayleid ruins, glows with a blue light. This hairpin features a sliver carved into the shape of a swan.
name: Welkynd Stone Swan Hairpin

title: Journal of Dreams
flavorText: If you record a night's dreams in this small gray book immediately upon waking, the dreams are fixed forever in your memory.
name: Journal of Dreams

title: Phantasmagorical Lens
flavorText: A strange multi-colored crystal in a golden hoop. When you peer through it, your surroundings come alive with ethereal visions.
name: Phantasmagorical Lens

title: Cactus-Blossom Salve
flavorText: A medicinal cream made from the blossoms of the Arkay's lash cactus. Useful for soothing sunburns and other irritations.
name: Cactus-Blossom Salve

title: Bog Beacon Spore Powder
flavorText: The dried spores of the bog beacon mushroom are reported to be effective against infection.
name: Bog Beacon Spore Powder

title: Ironwood Nut Salve Jar
flavorText: Black Marsh Argonians sometimes use the hard shell of the ironwood nut as a jar for salves and unguents.
name: Ironwood Nut Salve Jar

title: Silver Lanceata Tea Tin
flavorText: Embossed with eerie images of spectral figures, this small silver tin holds tea made from the spores of the lanceata pholiota.
name: Silver Lanceata Tea Tin

title: Seriweed Distillate
flavorText: The seriweed grows only in Black Marsh and is extremely rare. Its distilled sap is a potent cure for many kinds of poison.
name: Seriweed Distillate

title: Pickled Haj Mota Gall Bladder
flavorText: Haj motas are not hard to find, but their gall bladders are highly poisonous. The trick is preserving them for medicinal use.
name: Pickled Haj Mota Gall Bladder

title: Mummified Harpy Talon
flavorText: Affixed to a short handle, this grisly trophy seems to have been made into a talisman. Or a backscratcher.
name: Mummified Harpy Talon

title: Pinned Black Marsh Butterfly
flavorText: A large black butterfly with blue starbursts on its wings, preserved in a glass box. Strangely, no one can identify the species.
name: Pinned Black Marsh Butterfly

title: Ayleid Arrowhead
flavorText: The archers of the long-vanished Ayleids preferred ornately barbed arrowheads made from dark, glassy stone.
name: Ayleid Arrowhead

title: Fourth Legion Centurion's Plume
flavorText: In the Xi-Tsei Massacre, Argonian warriors wiped out an Imperial legion. This horsehair crest is a trophy of that victory.
name: Fourth Legion Centurion's Plume

title: Akaviri Governor's Stamp
flavorText: A signet stamp of gold, made for a high official. The design shows a stylized Dragon's head ringed by Akaviri runes.
name: Akaviri Governor's Stamp

title: Minotaur-Chief Horncap
flavorText: An ornate bronze cap that was once fitted over the end of a very large Minotaur's horn. Still quite pointy.
name: Minotaur-Chief Horncap

title: Onyx Haj Mota Figurine
flavorText: The representation is simple, almost child-like, but the stone is smoothly polished.
name: Onyx Haj Mota Figurine

title: Soapstone Castle Paperweight
flavorText: A handcarved miniature that appears to be a depiction of Leyawiin Castle.
name: Soapstone Castle Paperweight

title: Moonstone Kothringi Maiden
flavorText: The Kothringi are gone, but they live on in their artwork and handicrafts. This graceful statuette is an excellent example.
name: Moonstone Kothringi Maiden

title: Golden Morihaus Statuette
flavorText: Morihaus, the Winged Bull, was a hero and demigod whose deeds helped forge the Alessian Empire.
name: Golden Morihaus Statuette

title: Argonian Amber Salamander
flavorText: A stylized representation of one of Black Marsh's predatory amphibians. Curiously warm to the touch.
name: Argonian Amber Salamander

title: Lacquered Wood Puzzle Box
flavorText: A small, well-made puzzle box that is surprisingly hard to open. It rattles when you shake it.
name: Lacquered Wood Puzzle Box

title: Decorative Skull Bottle
flavorText: Made from thick green glass, this bottle is designed to resemble a human skull with a silver stopper at the crown of the head.
name: Decorative Skull Bottle

title: Emperor Moricar Decennial Coin
flavorText: A commemorative coin struck to mark the tenth anniversary of Emperor Moricar's coronation. It's a poor likeness.
name: Emperor Moricar Decennial Coin

title: Miniature Silver Dagger
flavorText: Mostly decorative, although a desperate warrior might stab a very small werewolf to death with a few tries.
name: Miniature Silver Dagger

title: Dragon Scale Scrimshaw
flavorText: Most scrimshaw is carved into tooth or bone, but the scale of a Dragon works too. The image depicts an Imperial galley.
name: Dragon Scale Scrimshaw

title: Sancre Tor Reliquary
flavorText: This small golden coffer contains a tiny molar. It is purported to be a preserved baby tooth of Emperor Reman II.
name: Sancre Tor Reliquary

title: Barsaebic Varla Diadem
flavorText: The Ayleids sometimes used varla, or starstone, to preserve memories. This delicate tiara holds glimpses of a forgotten queen.
name: Barsaebic Varla Diadem
